title: Optimizam result
description: The outcome of solving a problem file. See docs/result-format.md.

version.description: Format version, "major.minor". This schema describes major version 1.

objective_bound.description: Optional, only with status not_proven_optimal: the best proven bound on the optimal objective value (an upper bound when maximizing, a lower bound when minimizing).

objective.description: Objective value of this solution. Present exactly when the problem's solve method is minimize or maximize.

variables.description: Every variable in the problem, by name. A scalar variable maps to a number; an indexed variable maps to a table nested one object level per index set, keyed by set element (integers written as strings), like parameter values.
